_description: Braintrust eval scorecard → AKSI control ID mapping. Braintrust experiments evaluate agent outputs with named scorers (faithfulness, factuality, hallucination_rate, safety, toxicity, bias, relevance, accuracy, etc.). Each named scorer maps to an AKSI control category, and per-event score values are bucketed by threshold into PASS / FLAG / FAIL. Inverted scorers (where lower is better — hallucination_rate, toxicity, bias) are interpreted in reverse against the same threshold band.
